definitions.explanation: The female reproductive organ of a flower, which receives pollen and develops into the fruit or seed. Contrasted with the {雄|お}しべ (stamen), the male part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雌|め}しべ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To examine the pistil of a flower.
When pollen reaches the pistil, fruit forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{雄|お}しべ→雄しべ：29501_oshibe⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雌|め}しべ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: In science class we learned the difference between the stamen and the pistil.

notes:
The female reproductive part of a flower, which receives pollen and becomes the fruit or seed. Usually written in kana, or as {雌|め}しべ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雄|お}しべ→雄しべ：29501_oshibe⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雌|め}しべ: stamen and pistil
- {雌|め}しべ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: the tip of the pistil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雄|お}しべ→雄しべ：29501_oshibe⟧: stamen — the male reproductive organ of a flower
- ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧: pollen — the powder that fertilizes the pistil

cross_references.note: stamen; the male part of a flower
